summary: Village tower at Floodwood, Saint Louis County; a Minnesota lookout list dates its 100-foot Aermotor to 1940, and it is still listed as standing.

events.note: A 100-foot Aermotor tower erected, per the Central US Lookouts Minnesota list. No builder named.

evidence.supports: tower stands in the village of Floodwood
evidence.quote: This fire tower stands in the village of Floodwood, Minnesota.

evidence.supports: in Saint Louis County, listed at 51N-20W-6
listed as standing by Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: The only build year (1940) comes from one compiled Minnesota list with no builder, owner or source named. Two web searches and several page reads found no staffing, fire, access or current-condition record. The Commons photo caption is the only description of the tower itself. Record had no built year; one added from the list. The 100-foot figure is the overall tower height as listed, so it is recorded as height_m 30.5 on the same basis as the Abbeville record. Wikidata names the tower after the village, consistent with the record.
